$comment: Reviewed npm advisory acceptances. Enforced by scripts/check-npm-audit.mjs.
Two-way: an unlisted moderate+ advisory fails, and an entry whose advisory is
gone fails so an acceptance cannot outlive its risk. Every entry needs a
reason, and the reason must be why the code is UNREACHABLE in the shipped
desktop app or why no fix exists — never that upgrading is inconvenient.
Added by audit 20260906 (C3), which found the gate disabled at
continue-on-error for a pnpm-410 problem that no longer reproduces.

GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9.reason: Dev-server path traversal in the website's VitePress toolchain. Same non-shipped dev-server surface as GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff.

GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm.reason: Windows existsSync bypass in launch-editor, reachable only from Vite's dev-server error overlay. vite@7 and vite@8 are pinned to patched lines by package.json overrides; the remaining instance is vite@5 under website>vitepress, whose 1.x line requires vite 5 and has no patched 5.x release. Website dev server only; the desktop app bundles built assets and never runs a Vite dev server.

GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff.reason: Dev-server path handling in the website's VitePress toolchain (website>vitepress>vite). Not shipped: the desktop app bundles built assets and never runs a Vite dev server. Fixed by a VitePress line that supports vite>=6.4.3.

GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr.reason: Windows-only file read through esbuild's own development server (servedir). esbuild 0.27.7 is reached only through build and test tooling: Vitest's browser mode (.>@vitest/coverage-v8>@vitest/browser>@vitest/mocker>vite>esbuild, the path pnpm audit reports), plus server__content's tsup bundler and Slidev's Vite. None of them starts esbuild's server: Vite serves with its own, tsup only bundles, and the shipped app contains no esbuild.

GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5.reason: Memory exhaustion validating oversized constrained collections. zod@4 is pinned to the patched line (>=4.6.6) by a package.json override; the remaining instance is zod@3.25.76, pinned exactly by @hypothesi/tauri-mcp-server, the devDependency that serves Tauri MCP to the E2E harness against debug builds. No patched 3.x release exists. Not shipped, and its input comes only from the local test client. Re-check when the harness moves to zod 4.
